design: Heavy-built adult female keeper with wide low skull and strong cheek jaw-lobes, pale thick scalp tendrils falling loosely to shoulders. Triangular bronze collar over a purple-and-ivory layered long robe, split broad sleeves and a strong leather sash. Both hands hold an open hinged ritual diptych with two matte teal panels in a bronze frame, no readable lettering. Mottled dark-grey hide.
